title: Fix missing schema re-exports causing test failures
body:
CI tests failed because `HttpMethod` and `FieldMappingSchema` were imported but not re-exported from modules where tests expected them.

## Changes

- **`router.zod.ts`**: Re-export `HttpMethod` from `shared/http.zod.ts`
- **`external-lookup.test.ts`**: Use `ExternalFieldMappingSchema` directly instead of aliased `FieldMappingSchema` to avoid naming conflict with base schema from `shared/mapping.zod.ts`

The issue surfaced when both `shared/mapping.zod.ts` and `data/external-lookup.zod.ts` exported a `FieldMappingSchema` through `data/index.ts`, causing ambiguous module resolution.

```typescript
// Before: router.zod.ts
import { HttpMethod } from '../shared/http.zod';
// HttpMethod not available to importers

// After: router.zod.ts  
import { HttpMethod } from '../shared/http.zod';
export { HttpMethod };  // Now available to downstream consumers
```
